reviews.title: Año de nacimiento
reviews.text: No permiten poner el año de nacimiento después del 2008 :(
reviews.reply: Dear customer, hello there! We thank you for your feedback and want you to know that we appreciate it very much. Unfortunately, we need to follow the legal requirements of your country. We have the following age restrictions for different countries: 16 years for the EU; 13 years for USA / Canada; 15 years for Australia; for all other countries -13 years. In the future, we plan to add a new feature - Family Member: Adult users will register an account, and then will be able to add a user less than the limited age.
